answer: One sybil defense is a stake-weighted delta bond. Each new identity must lock a small deposit, and its voting weight grows only with the delta between its age and its last slash event. If a cluster of accounts shares a funding thread or posts within the same timing gale, a reviewer can flag them; proven duplicates forfeit every bond. An attacker running a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand deposits for weeks and risks losing all of them at once, so cheap mass identities stop being cheap.
